basic_info.description: The ADS42JB49 is a dual-channel, 14-bit, 250-MSPS analog-to-digital converter with JESD204B serial interface. It features high linearity, differential full-scale input of 2 VPP and 2.5 VPP, aperture jitter of 85 fS rms, channel isolation of 100 dB, and power dissipation of 850 mW per channel. Designed for communication, radar, and test systems.

seo.meta_description_en: ADS42JB49 14-bit, 250-MSPS dual-channel ADC with JESD204B interface. Features 850mW/ch power dissipation, 100dB channel isolation, and 85fs aperture jitter. Ideal for communications and radar systems.
seo.meta_description_zh: ADS42JB49 14位双通道模数转换器，采样率250MSPS，支持JESD204B接口。功耗850mW/通道，通道隔离度100dB，孔径抖动85fs，适用于通信与雷达系统。
